title: Daggers
description: A lightweight weapon mod that introduces custom 3D daggers. Offers rapid-strikes and single-target damage without the vanilla sweep attack.
body:
🗡️ Daggers

A Fabric mod introducing highly detailed, fast-attacking Daggers!

![Showcase 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cukkoo12/Daggers/main/docs/screenshot1.png) ![Showcase 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cukkoo12/Daggers/main/docs/screenshot2.png) ## Overview **Daggers** is a lightweight Fabric mod that adds a rapid-strike alternative to traditional swords. With custom 3D models and carefully balanced mechanics, daggers are perfect for players who prefer fast, precise combat. ## ✨ Features * **Single-Target Strikes:** Daggers **do not** trigger the vanilla sweep attack. Perfect for precise combat in crowded areas without accidentally hitting your pets or allies! * **High-Speed Combat:** Extremely fast attack speeds (up to 3.0) balanced by lower base damage. * **Custom 3D Models:** Beautifully designed 3D models with unique textures (golden shines, diamond crystal reflections, and netherite lava cracks). * **Headstab Mechanic:** A fun and dangerous easter egg! Equipping a dagger directly into your helmet slot will deal 2.5 damage (1.25 hearts) to you. Don't play with knives! * **Dedicated Creative Tab:** All items are neatly organized in the custom "Daggers" creative tab. ## 📊 Variants & Stats | Material | Damage | Speed | Special Trait | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | | **Iron** | 3 | 2.5 | Reliable and standard. | | **Gold** | 2 | 3.0 | The fastest, but most fragile. | | **Diamond** | 4 | 2.5 | High durability. | | **Netherite** | 5 | 2.5 | Fireproof, highest damage. | *(For comparison, a vanilla Iron Sword deals 6 damage with 1.6 speed)* ## 🛠️ Crafting Recipes **Standard Daggers (Iron, Gold, Diamond):** * 1x Stick (Bottom) * 1x Material Ingot/Gem (Top) **Netherite Dagger:** * Crafted in a Smithing Table: `Diamond Dagger` + `Netherite Upgrade Template` + `Netherite Ingot` ## ⚙️ Requirements * **Minecraft:** 1.20.1 * **Mod Loader:** Fabric * **Dependencies:** Fabric API
